title_ne: स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान प्रतिष्‍ठान सम्बन्धी केही नेपाल ऐनलाई संशोधन गर्ने विधेयक, २०८३
summary:
The Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Relating to Health Science Academies, 2083 aims to streamline and manage health science institutions across Nepal. Introduced by the Ministry of Health and Food Safety, the bill seeks to enhance governance, service delivery, and accountability in the health sector by standardizing terms of office and appointment mechanisms for key academy officials. It also repeals a prior ordinance on the subject while preserving actions taken under it.

Key Provisions:
- Establishes clear appointment procedures and tenures for key executive and academic positions, including Vice-Chancellors, Rectors, Registrars, Deans, and Hospital Directors.
- Sets a 5-year tenure for the Vice-Chancellor, Rector, Registrar, and Hospital Director at the B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences.
- Fixes a 4-year tenure for Vice-Chancellors, Rectors, Registrars, Deans, and Directors across the National Academy of Medical Sciences (NAMS), Patan, Karnali, Pokhara, and Rapti Health Science Academies.
- Mandates a recommendation committee chaired by the Pro-Chancellor with two members to recommend Vice-Chancellor appointments to the Chancellor.
- Updates the definition of 'Ministry' in the Pokhara Academy of Health Sciences Act to the Ministry of Health and Food Safety.
- Repeals the Health Science Academies Ordinance, 2083, while validating all actions taken thereunder and reviving prior legal provisions that were previously repealed by the ordinance.

Scope / Applicability:
Applies to six major health science institutions governed under their respective acts: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences (2049), NAMS (2063), Patan (2064), Karnali (2068), Pokhara (2072), and Rapti (2074).

Important Definitions / Institutions:
Updates the institutional context for the specified health science academies and formally updates references to the Ministry of Health and Food Safety.

Timelines and Procedural Requirements:
The act comes into force immediately upon enactment. Vice-Chancellors are to be recommended through a three-member committee chaired by the Pro-Chancellor prior to formal appointment by the Chancellor.
